detail.longDescription: A "deepswapp" of a website has data from one website in a layout of another website. Deepswapp Browser allows users to seamlessly browse this alternative version of the Internet, today. Video: https://deepswapp.com/assets/deepswapp.mp4 The whole Web can look like Wikipedia, old Reddit, or your own website. Once deepswapped, the website transformation is reusable without AI. Single-file HTML page Only essential data rendered Synchronized tabs Synchronized scrolling No backgrounds No animations Data auto-refresh Image lazy loading This desktop app works on every platform (Docker images also available) and opens a separate Chrome instance, which mirrors opened tabs in the user's main browser. Several deepswapps are included with the download, so no AI subscription is needed for a test drive. A fresh deepswapp takes around 10 minutes and costs about $0.40c on deepseek-v4.1-flash. This goes down by half when deepswapping a known website. Tech side: fully in Golang, with AI-generated JavaScript never executing in the user's main browser. Roadmap: Web and Mobile access, even deeper swaps, parallel swaps. https://deepswapp.com
